Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, Please Welcome The Newest Record Holder: Jasper Jenkins, The Oldest Human To Ever Live!

The room erupts in applause as Jasper is presented with the certificate and a bouquet of flowers. He smiles, his eyes shining with pride.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper lies in bed, surrounded by photos and mementos from his long life. He gazes up at the ceiling, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes land on a dusty old book on his nightstand.

JASPER
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

He picks up the book, blowing off the dust. The title page reads: "Quantum Immortality: A Theoretical Framework for Eternal Life".

Jasper's eyes scan the pages, his mind racing. He recalls reading about this theory in his youth, a radical idea that suggested that every time a person dies, their consciousness creates a new universe, allowing them to live on in some form.

JASPER
(whispering)
It's true... it's true...

As he delves deeper into the book, Jasper's expression changes from curiosity to horror. He begins to see the world in a different light.

JASPER
(panicked)
What if I'm not really dead? What if I'm just... stuck in some infinite loop of existence?

He starts to pace around the room, his mind spiraling out of control.

JASPER
(terrified)
What if I've been living in a simulation? A never-ending cycle of birth, death, and rebirth?

The room begins to blur and distort, like a funhouse mirror reflecting Jasper's fractured psyche.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S MIND - NIGHT

Jasper's consciousness expands, revealing a vast, labyrinthine universe. He sees himself as a tiny, insignificant speck, trapped in an infinite loop of existence.

JASPER
(whispering)
I'm not alive... I'm just a quantum fluctuation...

The camera zooms out, showing Jasper's mind as a swirling vortex of colors and patterns.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper collapses onto his bed, his body shaking with sobs. He covers his face with his hands, as if trying to block out the truth.

JASPER
(whispering)
I don't want to live anymore...

The camera lingers on Jasper's face, his eyes closed in despair. The screen fades to black.

FADE OUT.
